in_sanskrit.name: अज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit name 'Aj' comes from the Sanskrit root 'ajas' which means 'not born' or 'unborn'. This name is also associated with the idea of a new beginning or the start of something new.

in_hindi.name: अज
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name 'Aj' has multiple meanings. It can mean 'free' or 'independent' (अज़ाद), or it can mean 'strange' or 'wonderful' (अजीब).

in_tamil.name: அஜ
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name 'Aj' means 'new' or 'fresh', and can also signify the beginning of something new.

in_telugu.name: అజ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name 'Aj' means 'new' or 'beginning', and can also signify the freshness of something.

in_marathi.name: Aj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Aj is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अज’ (aj) which means ‘not born’, ‘immortal’, or ‘breath’ in Hindu mythology. This name is associated with the concept of the eternal soul and the breath of life.
